broadcasts.message: normalize.js ready. Implements NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse to single space, trim. No extra modifications. Awaiting tokenizer and pipeline.

tokenizer.js implemented. tokenize(text) calls injected normalize(text), then extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes using regex /[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*/g. Returns array in input order, empty array for no matches. No shadowing of normalize. Ready for pipeline integration.
Pipeline implemented. Uses null-prototype object for frequencies to safely handle tokens like 'constructor'. Returns text as joined tokens. Ready for integration.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 1: I own normalize.js. Must implement normalize(text) per spec: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. No other changes. No shadowing injected deps. Return JSON with files, memory, message.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 1: Task is to implement tokenizer.js. Injected normalize(text) is in scope; tokenize(text) must call normalize(text) first, then extract ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes using regex /[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*/g. No shadowing. No exports. Return array. Keep tokens in order. Next rounds may need to coordinate with pipeline.js.
private_memories.integrator: Round 1: Implemented pipeline.js per spec. processText calls injected tokenize, returns {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. Used Object.create(null) for frequencies to handle prototype names. text is tokens.join(' '). No shadowing of normalize/tokenize. Ready for review.
